articles.title: Top & Bottom Bond Funds 2Q26: Bond Markets Rebound, but Rate Risks Remain
articles.claim_summary: Bond funds staged a broad rebound in 2Q26 as pressures from an earlier energy shock subsided, though persistent interest rate risks make short-to-medium duration bonds and investment-grade credit the optimal allocation strategy.

findings.title: Asian stocks, bonds to drop as Fed hike bets mount - The Edge Singapore
findings.reason: The report indicates that Asian bonds are poised to drop as bets on Federal Reserve interest rate hikes mount, confirming that persistent interest rate risks remain an ongoing pressure on bond markets.

articles.title: Q&A Series: Manulife Global Healthcare Fund
articles.claim_summary: Manulife Investment Management outlines the investment strategy and market outlook for the Manulife Global Healthcare Fund, highlighting exposure to global healthcare equities. The fund's thesis centers on long-term secular growth driven by demographic aging, biopharmaceutical innovation, and defensive demand across healthcare sub-sectors.

findings.title: FDA warns of vision loss risk linked to popular GLP-1 drugs like Wegovy, Zepbound - CNBC
findings.reason: The FDA's safety warning regarding potential vision loss risks associated with leading GLP-1 drugs such as Wegovy and Zepbound materially complicates the thesis that biopharmaceutical innovation will reliably drive secular healthcare growth.
